text: Safari crashes on iPad whenever a customer tries to export a PDF report.
Search becomes very slow when filtering large workspaces and sorting recent results.
New users get stuck during workspace setup because the invite step is confusing and the instructions are unclear.
Customers want a new feature to export audit logs as CSV.
Button labels overlap in the settings modal on small screens and the layout breaks.
In Safari the search autocomplete dropdown closes after the first keystroke.
The first-run setup wizard should offer sample workspace templates.
Scrolling the dashboard feels janky after loading hundreds of rows in the browser.
